facts.fact: The Ministry of Innovation and Technology says the Digital Ethiopia 2030 strategy is grounded in digital sovereignty, with a sovereign national cloud and strict enforcement of data sovereignty laws as its backbone.

ETH.note: No hosting or contract terms stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Innovation and Technology says the Digital Ethiopia 2030 strategy was launched in the presence of Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, a five-year digital transformation phase; the article does not say it was adopted.
The Ministry of Innovation and Technology describes Digital Ethiopia 2030 as a five-year journey to 2030.

ETH.note: A sovereign national cloud is a strategy aim only; no data centre in service stated.
Cash-lite economy aim only; no survey share.
Nothing stated beyond a projection of growth in digital transactions.
An Entrepreneurship Development Policy to empower 5,000 startups is named, but no startup law, strategy status, labelling or fund is stated.
Technology hub used as a figure of speech; no hub or park stated.
